purpose: Compute four unchanged historical model distributions from NEW caller-supplied genre/instrument profiles under an exact observed native artist-album context. Not saved-score lookup or source-observed track inference.
build: Read only exact pinned metadata, original outer-model payload, selected-model payload and externally pinned trusted study receipt. Accept honestly fresh study envelope when same payload hash/protocol/runtime is validated. No original human annotations/evaluation/prediction payloads required. Verify all original training components excluded from their own routed outer fold. No fit/refit or acquisition calls.
models: Five unchanged outer weights (training prior, sorted literal vocabulary, nine-by-vocabulary Bernoulli probabilities), selected scalar T and fallback reason, fixed nine-class order and literal uploader mapper. Never recompute or rescale weights during export.
routing: Every exact observed artist_id,album_id pair and its complete-metadata minimum-track component_id/fixed five-fold assignment. 713 artists,2365 albums/pairs,713 components. No per-track roster, tags/profiles, predictions, votes, source paths, inner models/logits or training rosters in exported capsule.

query.native_ids: Strict positive uint32 integers; reject bool/string/float/zero/negative/out-of-range. No track_id or human target fields.
query.order: Preserve request order and duplicate profiles; each gets zero-based query_index, never an asserted native recording identity.
query.tags: 0..250 unique literal strings matching ^(genre|instrument)---[a-z0-9]{1,64}$; no whitespace/case/alias normalization or duplicates. Empty tags allowed, use original full-absence math. Well-formed unseen tags allowed and explicitly UNSEEN_BY_NB for routed vocabulary; fixed literal mapper may still consume them.
query.routing: Require exact observed pair in addition to known matching artist/album components. Never fuzzy-match, assign new component/fold or choose another model. Unknown/conflicting context abstains all methods. Invalid JSON/schema/type/tags abort request atomically.
query.feature_evidence: Count recognized NB vocabulary tags; report sorted UNSEEN_BY_NB and fixed mapper matched classes. Caller tags/context are assertions, not verified source observations.

math: Unchanged nine-class Bernoulli presence+absence logits plus log prior; stable logsumexp normalization. Prior and literal mapper remain original. Selected temperature applies to RAW logits/T, not clipped saved probabilities. T1 copies unscaled NB list exactly; empty vocabulary unscaled equals prior and T>1 softens raw prior logits. No score pooling, fitting, selection, clipping/renormalization or quality optimization.
manifest: External SHA256 pin, exact two-file closed inventory and physical hashes/sizes, strict schema/joins/finite numeric validation, source/protocol/payload pins, CC-BY-NC-SA attribution and runtime pins. Builder code/native parser hashes recorded as provenance; pure runtime code+CLI/Python/NumPy/SciPy verified without importing builder/source/training modules. Fresh atomic publication and output/input overlap rejection.
validation: API parity on all11565 original allowed-feature profiles in chunks<=100:416340 method/class probabilities. This is validation only; no fit/selection/evaluation optimization. Custom profiles under same known pair must change computed probabilities and match independent math. Strict schema/IDs/tags/unknown/conflicting/unobserved contexts; tampered/resealed malformed model/routing/provenance/runtime; actual CLI relocated with original inputs/training imports/refits/network denied.

rights.attribution: Music Technology Group; Bogdanov, Won, Tovstogan, Porter and Serra (2019), The MTG-Jamendo Dataset for Automatic Music Tagging; Music Classification Annotations documentation
rights.commit_policy: Only code/contracts/restrained attributed aggregates committed. Capsule models/routing, caller queries/results and parity datasets remain local noncommercial research artifacts; no serving/default integration/deployment.

interpretation: Caller-supplied profile distribution from the known historical model under a previously observed context, not verified recording features, genre membership, source observation, fresh quality/calibration confirmation, musical similarity, retrieval relevance or EveryNoise parity. Prior exploratory negative Brier/underconfidence findings remain.
